market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open higher on easing oil and yields, but Fed rate hike and AUD weakness cap gains. Volatility elevated around 2pm AEST Fed decision. Banks and miners lead; energy mixed. Qantas strike and fuel supply crunch add idiosyncratic risk. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow range with upside capped by AUD headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA resource exploration, AI datacentre capex, and domestic consumer recovery support 6–12 month upside. However, RBA rate path, fiscal tightening (IMF), and Middle East oil risk create a volatile backdrop. Superannuation reform debate may redirect fund flows. Net: cautiously constructive with sector rotation favouring quality and domestic revenue.
